import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    # Generating random board of size m x n
    m = random.randint(1, 12)
    n = random.randint(1, 12)
    board = [[random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(m)]
    
    # Generating a list of random words
    num_words = random.randint(1, 20)
    words = [''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=random.randint(1, 10))) for _ in range(num_words)]
    
    return board, words
